new.title: New
new.description: Creates a new Auth0 API client using an OAuth2 token source. Use this when you already have a token from another source.
new.signature: func New(ctx context.Context, domain string, opts ...Option) (*API, error)

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Functional options to configure the client.

returns.description: The configured API client, or an error if initialization fails.

new-with-client-credentials.title: NewWithClientCredentials
new-with-client-credentials.description: Creates a new Auth0 API client using the client credentials flow. The client automatically fetches and refreshes the Management API token.
new-with-client-credentials.signature: func NewWithClientCredentials(ctx context.Context, domain, clientID, clientSecret string, opts ...Option) (*API, error)

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Functional options to configure the client.

returns.description: The configured API client, or an error if initialization fails.

authentication-api.title: AuthenticationAPI
authentication-api.description: Provides access to the Auth0 Authentication API endpoints for login, logout, and token operations.

constructor.signature: func NewAuthenticationAPI(ctx context.Context, domain, clientID, clientSecret string, opts ...authcore.Option) (*AuthenticationAPI, error)

login-with-auth-code.title: LoginWithAuthCode
login-with-auth-code.description: Exchanges an authorization code for tokens using the Authorization Code flow.
login-with-auth-code.signature: func (a *AuthenticationAPI) LoginWithAuthCode(ctx context.Context, params oauth.LoginWithAuthCodeRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*oauth.TokenSet, error)

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Request parameters including Code and RedirectURI.

returns.description: Token set including access token, ID token, and optionally a refresh token.

throws.description: if the authorization code is invalid or expired.

logout.title: Logout
logout.description: Builds the logout URL to redirect the user to in order to end their Auth0 session.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameters including optional ReturnTo redirect URL.

management-api.title: ManagementAPI
management-api.description: Provides access to the Auth0 Management API. Manage users, connections, applications, roles, and tenant settings.

constructor.signature: func New(ctx context.Context, domain string, opts ...Option) (*API, error)

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Functional options to configure the client.

users-create.title: Users.Create
users-create.description: Creates a new user in the specified database connection.
users-create.signature: func (m *UserManager) Create(ctx context.Context, u *User, opts ...RequestOption) error

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: User object to create. Connection is required.

returns.description: nil on success, or an error describing what went wrong.

users-read.title: Users.Read
users-read.description: Retrieves a user by their ID.
users-read.signature: func (m *UserManager) Read(ctx context.Context, id string, opts ...RequestOption) (*User, error)

returns.description: The user object, or an error if not found.

users-update.title: Users.Update
users-update.description: Updates an existing user. Only the fields set on the User struct are updated.
users-update.signature: func (m *UserManager) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, u *User, opts ...RequestOption) error

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Fields to update. Only non-nil fields are sent.

users-delete.title: Users.Delete
users-delete.description: Permanently deletes a user by their ID.
users-delete.signature: func (m *UserManager) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string, opts ...RequestOption) error

user-type.title: User
user-type.description: Represents an Auth0 user. All fields are pointers so only set fields are included in API requests.

properties.name: EmailVerified
properties.description: Whether the email address has been verified.

properties.name: Picture
properties.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

properties.name: Connection
properties.description: The connection the user belongs to. Required when creating a user.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: The user's password. Write-only, never returned.

token-set.title: TokenSet
token-set.description: Represents the token response from a successful authentication.

properties.name: IDToken
properties.description: The ID token (present when openid scope is requested).

properties.name: RefreshToken
properties.description: The refresh token (present when offline_access scope is requested).
